name: Itsuka no Yoru
source:
You have been assigned to guard a dragon girl set to be executed at the end of 5 days. If she tries anything shady or attempts to hurt you, push that button right in front of you.
It will execute her instantly.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3030980]Steam[/url]]
